title: SEC Insider tab: filing-level rows render every economic field blank and colour the absent Direction as green (acquired)
repro: GET /sec/insider/AAPL (own sidecar :52323 and shared :52152, identical) -> 9 transactions, every row has reporter_name:"", reporter_cik:"", direction:null, shares:null, price_per_share:null, transaction_value:null, transaction_code:"". src/modules/sec/InsiderTradingTable.tsx:62-70 renders the Direction cell as {t.direction} — for direction=null this is an EMPTY span styled text-positive (green), i.e. a row with zero trade detail displays as if it were a 'buy' with no visible text explaining why. Reporter/Shares/Price/Value columns are also blank for every row with no 'not disclosed by this filing' label.

title: OpenRouter default free slug (inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-vl:free) 404s upstream as 'unavailable for free' as of this round
repro: vy.py invoke copilot ... --provider openrouter (no --model, i.e. vy.py's FREE_DEFAULT) --port 52320 -> HTTP-level 404 from OpenRouter itself ('This model is unavailable for free. The paid version is available now - use this slug instead: inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-vl'), surfaced by the app as a clean humanized error frame (code model_not_..., action 'Choose a different model in Settings'), not a stack trace or CORS-masked 500.
